title: Technology Sector Update for 10/22/2018: AMD.AXE.V,YNDX,FIVN,CRM - Nasdaq.com
text:

Technology stocks were higher on Monday afternoon, with shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding 0.75% while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising more than 0.5%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Yandex N.V ( YNDX ) was hanging on to a more than 1% gain Monday afternoon, giving back almost all of an 11% advance. The company said the board's review of strategic alternatives may or may not lead to any proposal to change its capital structure or to any potential transaction.
In other sector news:
(+) Five9, Inc. ( FIVN ) was more than 4% higher this afternoon. The cloud contact center software company said Ryan Kam has joined the company as chief marketing officer.
